findings.claim: The join-on-re-save step archives only keys of the form <key>/part-N. Importer claimTopicKey can move a part key to <key>/part-N~M when the original key is taken; re-saving such a document with its topic_key leaves the moved-key parts active beside the joined memory, duplicating content in search. The raised cap makes shrinking to one memory the normal path. Not traced end to end; needs an imported document with moved part keys.
The join test uses parts Save created; no test covers an imported split document with ~N part keys or an edited part 1 title, the cases where savedPartCount and the archive loop leave later parts.
Bodies up to 64 KB embed more chunks per save; with Ollama a large save can run longer or time out, leaving the memory pending for EmbedPending (no data loss). Not measured.

evidence: Read save.go and import.go in full in the worktree.
